raw_response:
This plot is small, only a quarter of a timad, and it is rented land so I must be careful with what I spend. Sorghum here in Amhara grows well with our rains, so I will not irrigate — the belg and kiremt rains are what I depend on. I cannot afford much chemical fertilizer, but I will put a little DAP and urea if the cooperative gives it on credit, and I will spread the manure from my cattle. I use the seed I saved from last harvest like my father did; pesticide costs too much, so my children and I will chase birds ourselves when the grain fills.
